senses.gloss:
मेह मेह, अस्, m. (according to some also)
अम्, n. (fr. rt. 1. मिह्), making water; urine, (मे-
हं कृ, to make water; अ-मेह, retention of
urine); urinary disease, excessive flow of urine, dia-
betes; a ram (= मेष); a goat; [cf. Gr. μοιχός.]
—मेह-घ्नी, f. ‘curing diabetes,’ Indian saffron.
—मेह-हाट, N. of a place; [cf. मेद-पाट.]
मेहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, urining, passing urine.
मेहत्नू, ऊस्, f., Ved., N. of a river.

मेहन, अम्, n. the act of passing urine; mem-
brum virile, the penis; the urinary duct; urine;
(अस्), m. a species of tree, = मुष्कक; (आ), f.
(according to some) = महिला, q. v.

मेहना, ind., Ved. (lit. in streams), abundantly.
—मेहना-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. bestowing abun-
dantly.

मेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of comps.) making
water; suffering from a particular urinary disease.
